zh:
走到火边，生火，再邀请伙伴选吃什么。
食材从仓库取用。
en:
Walk to the fire, light it, then invite companions to choose a meal.
Ingredients come from storage.

zh: 只邀请选中的伙伴，选好后再看菜单。
en: Only checked companions will be invited. Choose them, then browse the menu.

zh: 基础烤物 · 一种食材，马上就好
en: Simple Grills · One Ingredient, Ready Soon

zh: 选好就开烤，食材从仓库取用。
en: Choose a dish, then start grilling. Ingredients come from storage.
This fish is no longer available.

zh: · 烤好就和受邀的伙伴一起吃。
en: · Share it with your guests when it is ready.
